dispositionVocabulary.KEEP_PUBLIC_READ_FLOORED: Live consumers in product code AND a declaration in all three shipped bundles. Retiring the emitter would break shipped app CSS. No action.
dispositionVocabulary.KEEP_COMMERCIAL_KIT: Live consumers, floored in dist/commercial.css. Governed by the commercial-surfaces programme, not the vertical engine bundles.
dispositionVocabulary.KEEP_TENANT_CHANNEL: Emitted only when a tenant configures the capability; the emission IS the capability. No static floor owed.
dispositionVocabulary.FLOOR_GAP_PENDING_OWNER: Live product consumers but the token is not declared in every shipped bundle, so the read silently resolves to the app's own fallback on the missing verticals. Flooring is measurable but NOT zero-delta; owner decides.
dispositionVocabulary.MIGRATE_THEN_RETIRE_PROPOSED: The legacy mirror carries a value the Modern canon lost. Migrate the value to the named Modern owner FIRST (zero-delta per vertical via the harness), then propose the mirror for retirement.
dispositionVocabulary.RETIRE_PROPOSED: PROPOSAL ONLY. Requires zero DS + zero app + zero artifact consumers, a named successor or justification, harness-proven no-loss, and owner sign-off.
dispositionVocabulary.RECONNECT: A real part exists whose rule should read the token; wiring it with the current shipped value as fallback is zero-delta by construction.
dispositionVocabulary.PRIVATE_CANONICAL: Skin-internal plumbing with a live internal consumer; rename to --_ds-* out of the public namespace.
dispositionVocabulary.MERGE: Converge with a named twin token.
dispositionVocabulary.KEEP_PARAMETRIC_RAMP: An unconsumed rung of a ramp whose derivation law is asserted for every rung by an executable test. The ramp is one contract, not N tokens; retiring a rung breaks the law and leaves an arbitrary ladder.
dispositionVocabulary.KEEP_CLOSED_VOCABULARY: A member of a vocabulary a test pins as CLOSED. Draining it is a deliberate decision over every member, never a per-token retirement.
dispositionVocabulary.KEEP_TENANT_CHANNEL_GAP_PENDING_OWNER: A tenant-gated compiler emission (`if (<tenantField>) vars[<name>] = <tenantField>`) with no consumer. The emitter is not dead code -- the CONSUMER is missing. Retiring the emitter alone strands the contract field. Owner decides: wire the part, or remove field and emitter together as a contract change.

The fallback fires only when --a is UNDECLARED; a DECLARED --a whose own chain is unresolved makes the whole declaration invalid at computed-value time and the fallback is never consulted.
